title: 第855章 战后猜测第854章 三战三
content_zh:
就在所有人都以为严永歌必死无疑的时候，张扬却停了下来。
他右手一招，将业力灯连同五十四颗佛珠全都收了起来，放回储物戒。
严永歌奇怪地望着他，不明白他为何突然收手。
“大统领，就此罢手，如何？”
魔族大统领此时已然落到严永歌身边，见她无大碍，也是松了口气。
作为长年征战的伙伴，严永歌绝对不仅仅只是他一名手下那么简单。
“如果我不答应呢？”魔族统领淡淡地问。
“在下相信，能再杀一次。”张扬傲然回道。
双方打到现在，大家的底牌也知道差不多了，没有了大阵防御的严永歌，无论是自己还是雷秋雪，都能轻易斩杀。他之所以不杀严永歌，是因为不想结一个强敌。
此时，沈青媚跟郭槐也过来了，双方各自回到自己的队伍。
“道友可是陆方正的徒弟？”魔族大统领问。
“说是也行，我毕竟得到了他的传承；说不是也行，我在此之前，也有自己的师承。”
张扬不想让人将自己跟陆方正完全绑在一起，所以才这么回答。
陆方正身上的恩怨太多了，他可不想背负。
“道友是古殿成员？”魔族大统领继续问。
张扬知道他心里在想些什么，说道：“大统领可以将在下当成一名散修，在下想做什么、不想做什么，都是在下的自由，没有任何人能左右。”
“多谢张道友手下留情，今日之事就作罢，希望他日不会战场相见。”
魔族大统领说完，带着两名手下冲天而起，瞬间消失在视线之中。
……
“张扬，多谢你帮忙。”

苏蓝枝第一时间，就过来道谢。
其余的族内元婴修士，也纷纷过来感激。他们看向张扬的目光，已经不仅仅是崇拜了，像是见鬼一般。
能将魔族大统领都打跑，单是这一战，足以让他名震大魔界。
“你哥当年帮过我，我欠他一个人情，自然不能见死不救。”说到这里，张扬话音一转，“对了，他跟苏婉儿去哪了？”
“前些日子，哥说找到了田程锦的消息，圣祖母跟他一起去，现在还没有回来。现在想来，应该是魔族大统领故意放出的假消息，趁圣祖母不在，过来夺棺的。”苏蓝枝后知后觉地说道。
“可能性很大。”张扬点了点头，又问，“他们什么时候能回来？”
“应该不用多久。张扬，你能不能留下来住几天，等圣祖母回来再走？”
张扬想了一下，征仙令都超十几年了，也不差这一阵子。苏婉儿不在，黑魔族也确实没办法保住始祖棺。
“那咱们就再留些日子。”张扬答应了。
“太好了，谢谢你。”
苏蓝枝大喜，赶紧命人去安排最好的住所。
……
魔树林某处，三道身影从天而降。
“大统领，对不起，坏了你的大事。”严永歌满脸惭愧。
“与你无关，是本统领大意了。没料到区区几十年间，他的实力会强到这种地步。”魔族大统领回道。
“大统领知道他们是什么身份？”严永歌很好奇。
“大约七十年前，天工院一日双婴，震惊了整个沧澜古界。一日两元婴倒是其次，最重要的是，这两人一人引动了七色雷劫，一人引动了九色雷劫。当初我听闻这个传闻，还以为只是沧澜古界造势，故意托大，现在看来传闻是真的，这两人实在是强得可怕。”
content_en:
Just when everyone thought Yan Yongge was bound to die, Zhang Yang stopped.
With a move of his right hand, he collected the karma lamp and the fifty-four beads and put them back into the storage ring.
Yan Yongge looked at him strangely, wondering why he suddenly stopped.
"Commander, how about we just let it go?"
The leader of the demon tribe had already landed next to Yan Yongge, and he was relieved to see that she was fine.
As a partner in long-term battles, Yan Yongge is definitely more than just one of his subordinates.
"What if I don't agree?" the demon leader asked calmly.
"I believe I can kill him again." Zhang Yang replied proudly.
The two sides have been fighting until now, and everyone knows their trump cards. Without a large defense formation, Yan Yongge can easily kill both himself and Lei Qiuxue. The reason why he didn't kill Yan Yongge was because he didn't want to make a strong enemy.
At this time, Shen Qingmei and Guo Huai also came over, and both parties returned to their own teams.
"Fellow Taoist, are you Lu Fangzheng's disciple?" asked the leader of the demon clan.
"It's okay to say yes, after all, I got his inheritance; it's okay to say no, I also had my own teacher before this."
Zhang Yang didn't want people to completely tie him to Lu Fangzheng, so he answered like this.
Lu Fangzheng has too many grievances, and he doesn't want to bear them.
"Fellow Taoist, are you a member of the ancient palace?" the demon leader continued to ask.
Zhang Yang knew what he was thinking and said: "The commander-in-chief can treat me as a casual cultivator. What I want to do and what I don't want to do are all my freedom. No one can control me."
"Thank you Daoyou Zhang for your mercy. Let's let it go today. I hope we won't meet on the battlefield in the future."
After the demon leader finished speaking, he rose into the sky with his two men and disappeared from sight in an instant.
…
"Zhang Yang, thank you for your help."
Su Lanzhi came over to thank him immediately.
The rest of the Nascent Soul cultivators in the clan also came over to express their gratitude. They looked at Zhang Yang with more than just admiration, as if they were seeing a ghost.
Being able to defeat all the demon leaders, this battle alone is enough to make him famous in the demon world.
"Your brother helped me back then. I owe him a favor. Naturally, I can't just ignore him." At this point, Zhang Yang changed his tone and said, "By the way, where did he and Su Waner go?"
"A few days ago, I said that I had found news about Tian Chengjin, and Saint Grandma went with him, but she hasn't come back yet. Now that I think about it, it must have been false news deliberately released by the leader of the Demon Tribe, who came to seize the coffin while Saint Grandma was away." Su Lanzhi said in hindsight.
"The possibility is very high." Zhang Yang nodded and asked, "When will they come back?"
"It shouldn't take long. Zhang Yang, can you stay for a few days and wait for the Holy Grandmother to come back?"
Zhang Yang thought for a moment and realized that the Immortal Conquest Order had been in existence for more than ten years, so it wasn't that long ago. Without Su Wan'er, the Black Demon Clan really couldn't save the coffin of the ancestor.
"Then let's stay a while longer." Zhang Yang agreed.
"That's great, thank you."
Su Lanzhi was overjoyed and quickly ordered people to arrange the best accommodation.
…
Somewhere in the magic forest, three figures descended from the sky.
"Commander, I'm sorry for ruining your important event." Yan Yongge looked ashamed.
"It has nothing to do with you, it's my commander's carelessness. I didn't expect that his strength would become this strong in just a few decades." The Demon Clan Commander replied.
"The commander-in-chief knows who they are?" Yan Yongge was curious.
"About seventy years ago, Tiangongyuan had two babies in one day, which shocked the entire Canglan Ancient World. Two Nascent Souls in one day was the second most important thing. The most important thing is that one of these two people triggered the Seven-Color Thunder Tribulation, and the other one triggered the Nine-Color Thunder Tribulation. When I heard this rumor, I thought it was just the Canglan Ancient World to create momentum and deliberately exaggerate it. Now it seems that the rumor is true. These two people are really terrifyingly powerful."
